verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a public Admin API for programmatically creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users, and states that anything possible in the dashboard can also be done via that API. It also documents a separate Flags API authenticated with an environment key, and its official MCP server and CLI both build on the Admin API, which corroborates programmatic access. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
